rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=72, pretrain_patience=72, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=579, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=ITER-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). DATA-COVERAGE lever on the BOARD CHAMPION. ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (FULL 579-slice train pool, ~69%->100% coverage), with pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 + pretrain_patience tracked 120->72 (early-stop stays disabled) to HOLD the HARD 1200s wall AND keep grad-step parity train_n*epochs (iter-7 400*120=48000; iter-8 579*72=41688, ~13% fewer steps as a budget-safety margin since iter-7 overran at 1308.6s). Base=iter-7 (the BREAKOUT, NEW #1, SSIM 0.9414/hr 0.4187 @itnet_k=1/tn400/ep120). KEEP itnet_k=1 (the iter-7 breakout) and residual_learning=False (the mandatory config-fix). MECHANISM (campaign_state.md, CONFIRMED): build_dataset calls load_val_split(split='train', n=train_n) -> a FIXED n-slice subset loaded ONCE; pretrain_denoiser merely reshuffles that subset each epoch (torch.randperm), NO RotatingSubsetDataset. So train_n=400 lets the denoiser see only ~69% of the 579-slice pool (3 ps-groups: 154@0.66192, 98@0.73979, 327@0.77873); train_n=579 raises coverage to 100%. This is the SAME confirmed lever that lifted uswin (200->480, hr 0.3532->0.3829, +0.0297) and itnet_v3 (200->400, hr 0.3123->0.3288, +0.0165) and itnet v1 (200->300). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr0 @ep12/tn200/k3 170s; iter-2 0.5888 @ep48 345s; iter-3 0.6230 @ep144 744s; iter-4 0.7039 @ep240 1237s; iter-5 0.7294/hr0 @ep120/tn400/k3 1411s; iter-6 0.6307 @ep144/tn200/k3 744s; iter-7 0.9414/hr 0.4187 @itnet_k=1/tn400/ep120 1308.6s (BREAKOUT, NEW #1, val_psnr 38.79, val_rmse 5.75e-4). CURRENT train_n=400 (~69% of 579 pool). (2) LIMITER: with itnet_k=1 unlocked, the binding limiter is now the TRAINED DENOISER's data coverage -- it only sees ~69% of the anatomy in the 579-slice pool because the fixed-subset loader never rotates. The single trained-denoiser+1-DC pass is excellent (0.9414) but the denoiser is data-coverage-limited, the proven climb lever for the end-to-end/denoiser trainers this campaign. (3) ONE KNOB: train_n 400->579 (full pool), pretrain_epochs traded 120->72 to hold budget; itnet_k=1 KEPT, residual_learning=False KEPT. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if train_n 400->579, val_ssim/hr rises ABOVE iter-7 0.4187 because the denoiser sees 100% vs 69% of the 579-slice anatomical variety at near-equal optimization, exactly as full-coverage lifted uswin/itnet_v3/v1. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.4187 (flat/down) at train_n=579, the denoiser is NOT data-coverage-limited at k=1 -- coverage is exhausted -- and iter-9 reverts to tn400 and probes pretrain_epochs UP (more denoiser convergence) as the next lever. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score. iter-7 per-epoch at tn400/k1 ~8.31s/epoch, fixed (214-slice per-sample val + figure) ~312s (1308.6 - 120*8.31). At tn579 per-epoch ~8.31*579/400=12.03s/epoch -> 72 ep: 72*12.03 + 312 = 1178s, UNDER 1200s (and grad-steps 41688 < 48000 gives extra margin vs iter-7's overrun). max_train_s=1050 (17.5-min HARD backstop) GUARANTEES the 214-slice per-sample val + figure finish inside the 30-min sbatch wall, ending the overrun risk. val_n=214 KEPT (ALL L277 slices, NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT, batch_size=2 (itnet_v2 needs bs=2 per six-box) -- NOTE solver FORCES bs=1+val_chunk=1 via per-sample-ps so this is moot. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (itnet.projector swap, bs=1+val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (no fov= override), grad_clip retained, itnet_k=1 KEPT, residual_learning=False KEPT.
